subject: note: I do not think that I am necessarily right in my views on suicide, nor do I think that I am particularly well-qualified to give them. What the reader will find in the following essay are impressions based on observation and reading. Nothing more.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
